clue.text: A treble quaking in Anglican church had finally sung

indicators.note: in says the shuffled letters sit inside the church abbreviation and the final letter

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of the word had
quaking means shaking, so the letters of a treble are jumbled

explanation.surface: A boy chorister trembles in an Anglican service but finally manages his solo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quaking' turns A TREBLE into LEBRATE, which goes between CE and D.
explanation.definitionFit: A person or event that is sung is praised in song, that is, extolled or celebrated.

clue.text: Learner gets cross about religious group

parts.note: to cut across a field is to cross it

clue.text: French astronomer all excited about origin of proton star

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go round the picked letter
excited means stirred up, so the letters of all are mixed
origin of takes the first letter of proton

parts.note: an ace is a star performer

explanation.surface: A French scientist gets thrilled about where a proton star comes from.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' reads as part of a 'proton star' but stands alone as a top performer; 'excited' is the anagram signal and 'about' the wrapping signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierre-Simon Laplace was an eighteenth-century French mathematician and astronomer of celestial mechanics.
